title: Zoning map change for 1455 Coney Island Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This rezoning would change an R5/C2-3 district to a C4-5D district at 1455 Coney Island Avenue in Midwood, Brooklyn, facilitating a nine-story, roughly 157,000 square-foot long-term care facility with about 300 beds, office space, a café and a house of worship. The City Council approved the City Planning Commission's decision on October 22, 2026.
